versions.changelog:
Monthly Travel Blind Box skill initial release – get 3 local weekend getaways with real-time weather and transport!

- Automatically recommends 3 diverse nearby cities based on weather, distance, and user preferences.
- Provides round-trip train/flight options with booking links for each weekend.
- Highlights must-see attractions and gives concise inspiration for spontaneous travel.
- Handles missing info by prompting for user location or relaxing weather/transport criteria.
- Requires FlyAI CLI for all searches, with thorough install/check instructions.
